run_rrc_evaluation: run the RRC simulation evaluation inside a Singularity container with a policy package
build_policy_in_container: build a policy package using colcon build inside a Singularity container
evaluate_policy_with_singularity: evaluate a policy by running evaluate_policy.py inside an isolated Singularity environment

review_main: review the main function that validates inputs and constructs the Singularity evaluation command
